name: my-api-test-server
description: Postman API Automation with Professional HTML Reporting

scripts.test:signup: newman run tests/postman_collection.json -e tests/postman_environment.json -d tests/data/signup_invalid_data.json --env-var base_url=http://localhost:3000 --folder "POST - Sign Up (Negative - Data Driven)" -r htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export ./reports/signup.html
scripts.test:order-create: newman run tests/postman_collection.json -e tests/postman_environment.json -d tests/data/order_create_invalid_data.json --env-var base_url=http://localhost:3000 --folder "POST - Sign Up (Positive)" --folder "POST - Login (Positive)" --folder "POST - Create Order (Negative - Data Driven)" -r htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export ./reports/create.html
scripts.test:order-update: newman run tests/postman_collection.json -e tests/postman_environment.json -d tests/data/order_update_invalid_data.json --env-var base_url=http://localhost:3000 --folder "POST - Sign Up (Positive)" --folder "POST - Login (Positive)" --folder "GET - Get All Products (Positive)" --folder "POST - Create Order (Positive)" --folder "PUT - Update Order (Negative - Data Driven)" --folder "DELETE - Cancel Order (Positive)" -r htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export ./reports/update.html
scripts.test:all: npm run test:signup && npm run test:order-create && npm run test:order-update

author: Christine Kim
